title: Chargeback Automation: The Ultimate Guide for Modern Merchants
summary: Unlock efficiency & boost win rates with chargeback automation. Learn how automated solutions protect your revenue & streamline dispute management for your business.
body_text: Are rising chargebacks eating into your profits and overwhelming your team? In the fast-paced world of e-commerce, manual chargeback management is no longer sustainable. Merchants today face an escalating tide of disputes, from legitimate customer issues to sophisticated fraud, each demanding meticulous attention and rapid response. The burden of manually fighting each dispute, deciphering complex reason codes, and adhering to strict deadlines drains resources and diverts focus from core business operations. It’s a battle that often feels unwinnable, leading to lost revenue, increased operational costs, and significant frustration. This traditional approach simply cannot keep pace with the volume and complexity of modern transactions. This comprehensive guide will demystify chargeback automation, revealing how this powerful technology can streamline your operations, significantly improve win rates, and safeguard your revenue. Discover the tactical insights needed to implement a robust chargeback automation strategy for your business, transforming your approach to dispute management. Understanding Chargeback Automation: What It Is and Why It Matters Chargeback automation represents a paradigm shift in how merchants manage payment disputes. It leverages advanced technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and sophisticated rules engines, to automatically handle the entire chargeback representment process. This strategic approach contrasts sharply with traditional, resource-intensive manual methods, offering unparalleled speed, accuracy, and scale. In modern e-commerce, where transaction volumes are high and dispute deadlines are tight, chargeback automation is not just an advantage—it's a necessity. It enables businesses to respond to disputes promptly and with optimal evidence, significantly improving their chances of recovering lost revenue and reducing operational overhead. This technology ensures that every chargeback is addressed systematically, minimizing human error and maximizing efficiency. The Growing Challenge of Manual Chargeback Management The complexities of manual chargeback management have become a significant pain point for merchants. Each dispute requires a deep dive into transaction data, customer communications, and delivery confirmations, all while navigating intricate card network rules and strict deadlines. This process is not only time-consuming but also prone to human error, leading to missed opportunities for successful representment. The financial and operational impact is substantial. Manual processes tie up valuable staff, incur high administrative costs, and often result in lower win rates due as to inconsistent evidence or delayed responses. Our clients often share stories of how manual processes, despite best efforts, frequently lead to missed deadlines and lost revenue, highlighting the unsustainable nature of traditional methods. Defining Chargeback Automation: Beyond Basic Tools Chargeback automation is the application of intelligent systems to manage and respond to payment disputes with minimal human intervention. It goes far beyond simple tracking or reporting tools by actively building and submitting compelling representment cases. This sophisticated technology analyzes incoming chargeback data, identifies the appropriate response strategy, and compiles all necessary evidence automatically. At its core, automated dispute management is about transforming a reactive, labor-intensive task into a proactive, technology-driven defense. It empowers merchants to reclaim control over their revenue by ensuring every eligible chargeback receives a robust and timely response, moving beyond basic tools to offer a comprehensive, intelligent chargeback protection system. How Chargeback Automation Works: The Mechanics Behind the Efficiency The effectiveness of chargeback automation stems from its sophisticated mechanics, which seamlessly integrate data, apply intelligent rules, and execute precise actions. At the heart of this chargeback technology lies the ability to ingest data from various sources, process it through advanced algorithms, and generate a compelling defense package. This systematic approach ensures consistency and accuracy in every dispute. From payment gateways and CRM systems to shipping providers and customer service logs, an automated system aggregates all relevant transactional data. This data then feeds into a powerful rules engine, complemented by AI and machine learning capabilities, to determine the optimal response strategy. The result is an automated chargeback defense that is both rapid and highly effective, minimizing manual effort and maximizing recovery. Key Components of an Automated System An effective chargeback automation software solution comprises several critical components that work in concert to streamline dispute management. These elements ensure comprehensive coverage and tactical response capabilities. Feature Description Integration Capabilities Seamlessly connects with payment processors, gateways, CRM, and shipping platforms to gather all necessary transaction data. Rules Engine A customizable system that applies pre-defined and custom logic to incoming chargebacks, determining whether to fight or accept a dispute. Evidence Compilation Automatically gathers and formats all relevant documents, such as transaction receipts, shipping confirmations, and communication logs, into a compelling representment package. Submission Portal Facilitates the automated submission of representment cases directly to the card networks or merchant acquirers, adhering to strict deadlines. Reporting and Analytics Provides detailed insights into chargeback patterns, win rates, and areas for improvement, enabling continuous optimization. The Automation Workflow: From Notification to Resolution Understanding the automated dispute workflow reveals the true power of chargeback process automation. It transforms a complex, multi-step process into a streamlined operation. Action Details Chargeback Notification The system receives immediate alerts from payment processors or merchant acquirers when a chargeback occurs, initiating the automated response process. Data Ingestion & Analysis Relevant transaction data, customer history, and supporting documents are automatically pulled from integrated systems. AI and ML algorithms analyze this data to identify patterns and determine the chargeback reason code and its specific requirements. Strategy Determination Based on predefined rules and intelligent analysis, the system decides whether to accept, fight, or flag the chargeback for human review. Factors like transaction value, win probability, and historical data influence this decision. Evidence Compilation If fighting, the system automatically compiles all necessary representment documents, such as proof of delivery, signed receipts, and communication records, tailoring the evidence to the specific reason code and card network guidelines. Automated Submission The complete representment package is then automatically submitted to the appropriate card network or merchant acquirer, ensuring compliance with strict deadlines. Monitoring & Reporting The system continuously tracks the dispute's status, providing real-time updates and generating detailed reports on outcomes, win rates, and potential areas for chargeback prevention. For more complex disputes, such as those entering `[chargeback arbitration process](INTERNAL-LINK-PLACEHOLDER: /chargeback-arbitration-guide)`, the system can flag for expert review. Core Benefits of Chargeback Automation for Merchants Implementing chargeback automation delivers a multitude of tangible benefits that directly impact a merchant's bottom line and operational efficiency. These advantages extend beyond simple cost savings, fostering a more resilient and profitable business model. By proactively managing disputes, businesses can safeguard their revenue, enhance customer relationships, and free up valuable resources. The strategic adoption of automated solutions significantly boosts chargeback win rates, leading to substantial revenue recovery. It also drastically reduces the operational costs associated with manual dispute management, allowing teams to focus on core business growth. Furthermore, chargeback automation plays a crucial role in fraud prevention by identifying suspicious patterns early, contributing to a more robust overall security posture. Boosting Win Rates and Recovering Revenue One of the most compelling benefits of chargeback automation is its ability to significantly increase win rates and, consequently, recover more lost revenue. Automated systems meticulously gather and present all required evidence for each dispute, tailoring the response to specific common chargeback reason codes and card network rules. This precision and speed are difficult to achieve manually. By ensuring every representment is robust, accurate, and submitted within strict deadlines, automation maximizes the chances of a favorable outcome. This proactive and data-driven approach means fewer legitimate sales are lost to disputes, directly impacting a merchant's profitability and providing a stronger successful chargeback representmen t strategy. Streamlining Operations and Reducing Costs Chargeback automation dramatically streamlines dispute management operations, translating into significant cost reductions for merchants. The automation of evidence gathering, case building, and submission processes eliminates the need for extensive manual labor, freeing up team members for higher-value tasks. This directly reduces administrative overhead and labor costs associated with fighting chargebacks. Beyond direct labor savings, automation helps avoid costly fees imposed by card networks for excessive chargebacks or missed deadlines. This operational efficiency allows businesses to scale their dispute management capabilities without proportionally increasing staff, directly improving their bottom line. The `[costs of manual chargeback management](INTERNAL-LINK-PLACEHOLDER: /manual-chargeback-costs)` are often far greater than anticipated, making automation a smart investment. Implementing Chargeback Automation: A Strategic Approach Successfully implementing chargeback automation requires more than just purchasing software; it demands a strategic approach tailored to your business's unique needs. This involves a thorough assessment of current processes, meticulous data preparation, and careful customization of automation rules. A well-planned implementation ensures maximum effectiveness and a smooth transition. Merchants must prepare their existing systems for integration, define clear objectives, and align their teams with the new automated workflows. This strategic foresight, combined with continuous monitoring and optimization, is key to unlocking the full potential of chargeback automation and building a resilient dispute defense. This section will guide you through the essential steps to implement chargeback automation effectively. Preparing Your Business for Automation Before diving into a solution, preparing your business for automation is crucial. This foundational step ensures a smoother transition and maximizes the effectiveness of the new system. Action Details Assess Current Processes Document your existing chargeback management workflow, identifying bottlenecks, pain points, and areas prone to human error. This helps define clear objectives for automation. Data Hygiene and Readiness Ensure your transaction data is clean, consistent, and easily accessible. Poor data quality can hinder automation's effectiveness. This includes verifying customer information, delivery details, and payment records. System Compatibility Evaluate the compatibility of your existing payment gateways, CRM, ERP, and shipping systems with potential automation solutions. Seamless `[data integration](INTERNAL-LINK-PLACEHOLDER: /data-integration-guide)` is paramount for efficient data flow. Define Clear Objectives Establish specific, measurable goals for automation, such as reducing chargeback rates by a certain percentage, improving win rates, or cutting operational costs. Team Alignment and Training Prepare your fraud and customer service teams for the transition. Automation will shift their roles, requiring training on how to monitor the system, handle exceptions, and leverage its insights. Best Practices for Maximizing Automation Effectiveness Implementing chargeback automation is an ongoing process that requires continuous refinement to yield the best results. These best practices ensure your automated system remains robust and responsive to evolving threats. Strategy Details Continuous Monitoring and Optimization Regularly review system performance, win rates, and chargeback patterns. Adjust rules and logic as needed to adapt to new fraud tactics or changes in card network regulations, such as `[Visa chargeback rules](EXTERNAL-LINK-PLACEHOLDER: https://usa.visa.com/dam/VCOM/download/merchants/chargeback-management-guidelines-for-visa-merchants.pdf - Visa's merchant chargeback guidelines)`. Leverage Analytics and Reporting Utilize the detailed reports generated by the automation software to gain insights into the root causes of chargebacks. This data is invaluable for refining `[comprehensive fraud prevention strategies](INTERNAL-LINK-PLACEHOLDER: /fraud-prevention-strategies)` and improving overall business practices. Integrate with Prevention Efforts While chargeback automation focuses on response, integrate its insights with your `[chargeback prevention](INTERNAL-LINK-PLACEHOLDER: /chargeback-prevention-guide)` strategies. Understanding why disputes occur can inform upstream changes to reduce future occurrences. Regular Rule Review Card network rules, such as `[Mastercard dispute guidelines](EXTERNAL-LINK-PLACEHOLDER: https://www.mastercard.us/content/dam/public/mastercardcom/na/en/documents/chargeback-guide.pdf - Mastercard's merchant chargeback guide)`, and common fraud patterns evolve. In our experience working with hundreds of merchants, the most effective automation strategies involve continuous monitoring and adaptation to evolving fraud patterns, ensuring rules are always current. Human Oversight for Exceptions While automation handles the bulk, maintain human oversight for high-value or complex cases that fall outside standard rules. This ensures nuanced situations receive appropriate attention. Choosing the Right Chargeback Automation Solution Selecting the best chargeback automation solution is a critical decision that can significantly impact your business's financial health and operational efficiency. The market offers various dispute resolution software options, each with distinct features and capabilities. A thorough evaluation process, focusing on key functionalities, scalability, and vendor support, is essential for making an informed choice. Prioritizing features that align with your specific operational needs and long-term growth objectives will ensure you invest in a platform that delivers maximum value. Beyond the technical specifications, assessing the vendor's expertise, support, and commitment to security and compliance is equally important. This section will guide you through the essential criteria for choosing the right chargeback automation software. Essential Features to Prioritize When evaluating chargeback automation features, certain functionalities stand out as critical for a robust and effective solution. Prioritizing these will ensure your chosen platform meets the demands of modern dispute management. Feature Description Robust Rules Engine Look for highly customizable rules that allow for dynamic decision-making based on various data points, specific `[reason codes](INTERNAL-LINK-PLACEHOLDER: /reason-codes-explained)`, and business policies. Comprehensive Integrations The ability to seamlessly connect with all your essential payment, CRM, and shipping systems is non-negotiable for complete data compilation. Detailed Reporting and Analytics Powerful reporting tools that offer actionable insights into chargeback trends, win rates, and performance metrics are crucial for continuous optimization. Scalability The solution should be able to handle increasing transaction volumes and chargeback rates as your business grows without compromising performance. Multi-Processor Support For merchants using multiple payment processors, the ability to integrate and manage disputes across all of them is vital. User-Friendly Interface An intuitive dashboard and workflow management system simplify oversight and exception handling for your team. Evaluating Vendors: Beyond the Sales Pitch Choosing a chargeback automation vendor requires diligence beyond comparing feature lists. The quality of support, the vendor's expertise, and their commitment to client success are equally important. Feature Description Vendor Expertise and Reputation Seek a vendor with deep industry knowledge and a proven track record in chargeback management. Check references and case studies. Customer Support Evaluate the level of support offered—24/7, dedicated account managers, training resources—as this is critical during implementation and ongoing operations. Security and Compliance Verify that the solution adheres to stringent data security standards like `[PCI DSS compliance standards](EXTERNAL-LINK-PLACEHOLDER: https://www.pcisecuritystandards.org/ - PCI Security Standards Council)` and relevant data protection regulations. Pricing Model Understand the pricing structure, including setup fees, monthly subscriptions, and per-chargeback costs, to ensure it aligns with your budget and expected ROI. Request Demos and Trials Always request a personalized demo to see how the solution addresses your specific challenges, and ideally, test it with a trial period. The Future of Chargeback Automation: What's Next for Merchants The landscape of chargeback automation is continuously evolving, driven by advancements in AI, machine learning, and the increasing complexity of payment ecosystems. For modern merchants, staying abreast of these trends is crucial for maintaining a robust and future-proof dispute management strategy. The future promises even more sophisticated tools designed to enhance both prevention and response capabilities. Expect to see deeper integration across the entire payment lifecycle, enabling more proactive fraud detection and prevention. The emphasis will shift towards hyper-personalization of dispute responses, leveraging granular data to build even more compelling cases. This forward-looking perspective demonstrates the ongoing innovation in chargeback technology, empowering businesses with smarter, more agile defense mechanisms against financial losses. According to `[global e-commerce growth trends](EXTERNAL-LINK-PLACEHOLDER: https://www.statista.com/statistics/379046/worldwide-retail-e-commerce-sales/ - Statista report on e-commerce growth)`, the need for advanced automation will only intensify. Advanced AI and predictive analytics will become even more sophisticated, moving beyond reactive dispute management to proactive prevention. This means identifying potential chargebacks before they occur, allowing merchants to take preemptive action, such as offering refunds or improved customer service. Hyper-personalization will enable automated systems to tailor evidence and arguments with unprecedented precision, further boosting win rates. Deeper integration across the payment ecosystem will create a seamless flow of data, enhancing the accuracy and speed of automated responses. Conclusion Chargeback automation is no longer a luxury but a strategic imperative for modern merchants navigating the complexities of the digital economy. By transforming manual, labor-intensive processes into streamlined, intelligent workflows, businesses can significantly improve their chargeback win rates, recover lost revenue, and dramatically reduce operational costs. This powerful chargeback protection system empowers teams to focus on growth rather than getting bogged down in dispute management. Embracing chargeback automation is an investment in your business's resilience and profitability, offering a clear path to enhanced efficiency and a stronger defense against financial losses. It's about leveraging cutting-edge technology to turn a costly challenge into a manageable, even profitable, aspect of your operations. Secure your revenue and optimize your dispute strategy today.

title: Vishay Saves Space While Improving Signal Quality
summary: Save space while delivering improved signal transmission quality and enhanced robustness against electrical spikes and RF and EMI issues
body_text: Vishay Intertechnology Automotive Optocoupler in SOP-5 Package With 3.6 mm Width Saves Space While Improving Signal Transmission Products mentioned: VOMHA43A For more information: Media Contact - Bob Decker, Redpines Phone: 1.415.409.0233 E-mail: bob.decker@redpinesgroup.com Sales Contact: http://www.vishay.com/ en/company/contacts/ This release in: English Deutsch MALVERN, Pa. — July 9, 2026 — Vishay Intertechnology, Inc. (NYSE: VSH) today introduced an automotive 1 MBd high speed optocoupler in a new SOP-5 package with a narrow width of 3.6 mm. Combining a comparative tracking index (CTI) of 400 with industry-leading minimum guaranteed common mode transient immunity (CMTI) of 40 kV/µS, the Vishay Semiconductors VOMHA43A is designed to deliver improved signal transmission quality and save space in applications requiring isolation voltages (VIORM) up to 707 Vpeak. The AEC-Q102 qualified device released today is optimized for isolated data communication, fast signal switching, ground signal isolation, and logic voltage level shifting in automotive, industrial, home and building control, and telecom applications. In electric (EV), hybrid electric (HEV), and low speed electric (LSEV) vehicles, the optocoupler provides communication bus isolation for CAN, LIN, I2C, and SPI interfaces, as well as isolated drive circuit applications such as intelligent power module (IPM) drivers. While previous SOP-5 packages offered a width of 4.4 mm, the narrower SOP-5 of the VOMHA43A requires less PCB space, while supporting stackable designs. The device’s minimum CMTI — which is more than double that of the closest competing device — provides enhanced robustness against electrical spikes and RF and EMI issues. And while competing devices offer maximum repetitive peak isolation voltages of 567 Vpeak, the optocoupler’s isolation voltage performance of 707 Vpeak meets the requirements of 400 V battery systems. The VOMHA43A consists of a GaAlAs infrared emitting diode, optically coupled with an integrated photodetector and a high speed transistor. The photodetector is junction-isolated from the transistor to reduce miller capacitance effects. The optocoupler features an open collector output function that allows designers to adjust load conditions when interfacing with different logic systems, while a Faraday shield on the detector chip allows the device to reject and minimize high input to output common mode transient voltages. The RoHS-compliant and halogen-free optocoupler operates over a temperature range of -40 °C to +125 °C and is pin to pin compatible with leading competing parts to provide a direct replacement and eliminate the need for electrical and mechanical redesigns. Samples and production quantities of the VOMHA43A are available now, with lead times of six weeks. Vishay manufactures one of the world’s largest portfolios of discrete semiconductors and passive electronic components that are essential to innovative designs in the automotive, industrial, computing, consumer, telecommunications, military, aerospace, and medical markets. Serving customers worldwide, Vishay is The DNA of tech.® Vishay Intertechnology, Inc. is a Fortune 1,000 Company listed on the NYSE (VSH). title: When the Impossible Became The Mission: Netflix Unveils the Gripping Trailer for 'Operation Safed Sagar'
summary: Rooted in real events, this specific chapter gave rise to Operation Safed Sagar, an untold chapter of the Kargil war and a historic, high-altitude mission that altered the course of the larger conflict.
body_text: Entertainment 19 July 2026 Global India Link copied to clipboard ~Inspired by the untold story of the Golden Arrows Squadron, Operation Safed Sagar premieres on Netflix on 7 August~ Images In the summer of 1999, as the Kargil War intensified and Pakistani forces occupied strategic positions across unforgiving mountain terrain, the Indian Army faced an unprecedented challenge. With the battle escalating and the stakes higher than ever, the Indian Air Force was called upon to support the mission. Rooted in real events, this specific chapter gave rise to Operation Safed Sagar , an untold chapter of the Kargil war and a historic, high-altitude mission that altered the course of the larger conflict. This story marks a defining moment in India’s history as the world’s highest air operation, performed by the Indian Air Force’s youngest squadron that rose to the occasion to answer the call of duty . Today, Netflix unveiled the trailer for Operation Safed Sagar , an epic military drama inspired by one extraordinary chapter of the Indian Air Force's role during the Kargil War. The series brings to life the untold story of the Golden Arrows Squadron, one of the many air warrior, naval, and army units that answered the nation's call during Operation Safed Sagar. Directed by Oni Sen, created by Abhijeet Singh Parmar and Kushal Srivastava, and produced by Sanjay Routray and Sarita Patil from Matchbox Shots LLP and Mehboob Pal Singh Brar from Feel Good Films, the series stars Siddharth, Jimmy Shergill, Abhay Verma, Dia Mirza, Prajakta Koli, Adil Hussain, Mihir Ahuja, Taaruk Raina, Arnav Bhasin, and Amrita Bagchi. The series was shaped through extensive research and first-hand consultations with Indian Air Force veterans. Filmed across operational Indian Air Force bases and supported by access to real Air Force aircraft and infrastructure, the series brings an unprecedented level of authenticity to the screen by being filmed across high-altitude operational environments to recreate the scale and intensity of the mission. At the heart of the story is the Golden Arrows squadron, India’s Youngest Fighter Pilots, led by Wing Commander B.S. Dhanoa ‘Tony’ (Jimmy Shergill) and seconded by Squadron Leader Ajay Ahuja (Siddharth). As war looms over the mountains of Kargil and the mission grows increasingly perilous, Ahuja and his young officers, including Flying Officer R.S. Dhaliwal ‘Dhali’ (Abhay Verma) , Flying Officer C.H. Bal Reddy ‘Baldy’ (Mihir Ahuja) , Flight Lieutenant Jitendra Sangwan ‘Sangy’ (Taaruk Raina) and Flying Officer Amit Gupta ‘Goofy’ (Arnav Bhasin) , must navigate impossible odds, life-and-death decisions and the immense responsibility that comes with serving the nation. Beyond the battlefield, the series also explores the lives of the families, the air force wives who stood behind the men in uniform, offering an intimate look at the love and unwavering support, along with their quiet courage that became the wind beneath the wings of the air warriors. The creators also engaged with the families connected to the operation to better understand the emotional realities behind the mission. Monika Shergill, Vice-President Content, Netflix India. said, “Some stories are a privilege to tell and Operation Safed Sagar is one of them. Bringing the Indian Air Force's role in the Kargil conflict to the screen has been our most ambitious production in India to date, made possible through the extraordinary support of the Indian Air Force. From our remarkable cast to Indian artists, technicians and VFX teams, every person behind this series has helped bring this story to life with authenticity, ambition and incredible craftsmanship, a reflection of the extraordinary talent that exists in India's creative ecosystem. We're equally proud to have young and fresh creators — Abhijit Parmar and Kushal Srivastava and the vision of director Oni Sen, who helped shape this project from the ground up. We also deeply value our partnership with Matchbox Shots for yet another riveting story with unforgettable characters. We hope audiences experience not just the scale of this series, but the courage, sacrifice and spirit at its heart." Reflecting on bringing this story to screen, Oni Sen, Director, Operation Safed Sagar , said, "From the very beginning, we wanted to tell the story of Operation Safed Sagar with honesty, scale, and emotional truth. While the operation itself is extraordinary, what stayed with us throughout this journey were the pilots, officers, and families whose courage, resilience, and sacrifices continue to inspire us. We're incredibly grateful to Netflix for believing in this story from the outset and for backing our vision with unwavering trust and conviction. They were true creative partners, championing the project and giving us the support and freedom to tell this story with the authenticity, ambition, and scale it deserved. I'm equally grateful to our producers, Feel Good Films and Matchbox Shots, our exceptional cast, and the entire crew, whose passion and dedication brought these real-life heroes to the screen with sincerity and heart. We hope this series stands as a fitting tribute to their courage and sacrifice, and that audiences around the world connect with their extraordinary story." Talking about the series, which benefited from the guidance and support of Air Chief Marshal (Retd.) B.S. Dhanoa, he said, “India is ready to hear this story now. In fact, it is long overdue. Operation Safed Sagar deserves to be told, and I’m glad it is finally being brought to life. When I was the Chief of the Air Staff, I had only two wishes. First, that the story of the Indian Air Force’s role in the Kargil War must be told. It is one of the most important chapters in our history. Second, that any film or series on this subject should inspire young boys and girls to join the Indian Air Force. Stories like these ignite young minds. Even today, after retirement, I keep telling veterans who have served in wars to visit schools and share their experiences. These stories have the power to inspire the next generation. If this series succeeds in igniting that spark and encourages more young Indians to join the Indian Air Force, I would consider that my objective achieved.” A story of courage in the skies, sacrifice on the ground, and a mission that defied impossible odds, Operation Safed Sagar brings to the screen a chapter of history that has never been told like this before. Operation Safed Sagar premieres on 7 August, only on Netflix. Sneh Kulkarni Publicity skulkarni@netflix.com Shraddha Soni Publicity ssoni@netflix.com Pankti Bhatt Coordinator, Publicity - India pbhatt@netflix.com

The relationship consists of five loans to four borrower entities with aggregate exposure of approximately $22 million to the Bank and is primarily secured by commercial real estate. The Company continues to evaluate the potential loss exposure associated with the relationship, monitor the bankruptcy proceedings, and assess underlying collateral values. Management believes the allowance for credit losses remains appropriate based on information currently available.
